## berth placement

the public keys that verify supervised processes' placement tokens

### Synopsis

A supervised process gets a short-lived token, signed by a key berth keeps on this machine and in no
container, that says which org's container it runs in (docs/api.md, placement proofs). These are the
public keys to verify one with: the one signing, and older ones until their last token has expired.

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_placement/

```
berth placement keys [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  berth placement keys
  berth placement keys --output json
```
